Every change is documented (founder rule, 1 Nov 2026: "always give detailed
reasons for the repo updates on each change to its tracked properly"). Fill in
every heading. Write "none" rather than deleting one. CLAUDE.md, section 2.8.
-->

## What
<!-- What changes for the learner, the admin or the system, in plain words. -->

## Why
<!-- The request, quoted with its date, e.g. Founder, 1 Nov 2026: "...". -->

## Cause
<!-- For a fix: what was actually wrong, and how it was found. -->

## How
<!-- The files and approach. Anything that behaves differently. -->

## How to test
<!-- Steps a person can follow, and the checks that were RUN, with real results
     (npm run test, build, check:i18n, browser screenshots...). Never list a
     check that was not run. -->

## Risk and rollback
<!-- What could go wrong, and how to undo it. -->

## SQL / deploy notes
<!-- Migrations to apply, in order, and who applies them (production is never
     changed from a PR). Write "none" if there are none. -->

## Related
<!-- Earlier PRs, sessions, reports. -->
